lead_raw_text:
The structure of Lu12Ge12 (reduced formula LuGe) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 24 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Ge and Lu centers adopt close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors per center atom: Ge is surrounded by 8 Ge and 4 Lu neighbors, while Lu is coordinated by 12 Ge neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component spanning all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between 12-vertex Ge and Lu coordination polyhedra, as well as corner- and edge-sharing between Ge polyhedra.
